---

# 1. Purpose

This document defines the long-term roadmap for the FamilyOS Build
Framework.

The objective is to provide strategic direction for the evolution of build
processes, automation, reproducibility, security, and delivery capabilities.

---

# 2. Scope

This roadmap applies to:

- build processes;
- automation infrastructure;
- artifact management;
- CI/CD workflows;
- developer experience;
- release preparation.

---

# 3. Roadmap Principles

The Build Roadmap SHALL prioritize:

- reliability;
- automation;
- reproducibility;
- scalability;
- delivery confidence.

---

# 4. Build Evolution Areas

The roadmap is organized around:

| Area | Objective |
|---|---|
| Automation | Improve build efficiency |
| Reproducibility | Guarantee consistent outputs |
| Security | Protect build integrity |
| Performance | Optimize execution |
| Artifacts | Improve delivery management |
| Developer Experience | Simplify workflows |

---

# 5. Short-Term Objectives

Short-term objectives include:

- completing build standards;
- establishing build validation;
- improving automation workflows;
- documenting build environments.

---

# 6. Medium-Term Objectives

Medium-term objectives include:

- improving CI/CD capabilities;
- expanding artifact management;
- increasing build automation;
- improving build diagnostics.

---

# 7. Long-Term Objectives

Long-term objectives include:

- intelligent build optimization;
- advanced build analytics;
- scalable build infrastructure;
- automated delivery pipelines.

---

# 8. Build Automation Evolution

FamilyOS SHOULD continuously improve:

- automated execution;
- validation workflows;
- artifact generation;
- pipeline reliability.

---

# 9. Build Maturity

Build maturity SHOULD evolve through:

- standardized processes;
- measurable performance;
- reliable automation;
- continuous improvement.

---

# 10. Ecosystem Support

As FamilyOS grows, build capabilities SHALL support:

- official plugins;
- community plugins;
- external integrations;
- multiple delivery targets.

---

# 11. Governance

Build roadmap changes SHALL follow FamilyOS governance processes.

Major changes SHOULD be documented through appropriate mechanisms.

---

# 12. Compliance

All build initiatives SHOULD align with this roadmap.

Exceptions SHALL be documented and approved.
